fiche: Un petit œil flottant et curieux qui hante les brumes et les ruines pour tout observer.
apparence: A floating eyeball creature with soft rubbery skin and wispy fins; dominant colors violet, magenta and glossy black.

stades.bebe: A round violet ball that is one huge shiny eye with tiny stubby fins.
stades.enfant: Two short wiggly feelers sprout on top and a pair of small fin-wings appear on the sides.
stades.ado: The body becomes teardrop-shaped with a frilled magenta eyelid crest and a trailing tail fin.
stades.adulte: A large eye-orb ringed by four floating mini-eyes on thin stalks, with a sweeping eyelid crest and wide fin-wings.
stades.ancien: The eye wears a cracked crystal monocle, its eyelid crest droops like bushy brows, and a faint iridescent halo circles it.

fiche: Une gelée vivante gourmande qui avale tout ce qui brille dans les marais toxiques.
apparence: A translucent jelly blob with floating objects visible inside its body; dominant colors toxic green, violet and black.

stades.bebe: A small round green jelly drop with two big dot eyes and a single bubble inside.
stades.enfant: Two stubby jelly arms bulge out and a wide smiling mouth appears.
stades.ado: The blob grows a wobbly crown of jelly spikes and a violet core glowing inside it.
stades.adulte: A huge sloshing mass with four thick pseudopod arms, a wide mouth and swirling trinkets suspended inside.
stades.ancien: The jelly turns murky with a mossy crust on top, an old lantern and coins drifting inside, and a long drooping jelly beard.

fiche: Un petit rampeur à tentacules qui se fixe sous les pierres des grottes humides.
apparence: A low crawling creature made of soft tentacles under a dome-shaped head; dominant colors magenta, violet and pale pink.

stades.bebe: A round magenta dome with big eyes and three tiny nub tentacles underneath.
stades.enfant: The nubs lengthen into six curly tentacles with little suction cups.
stades.ado: The dome flattens into a hood with bony ridges and two longer front tentacles ending in clamps.
stades.adulte: A wide hooded crawler with eight strong tentacles, ridged studs on its hood and glowing violet spots.
stades.ancien: The hood is crusted with tiny barnacles and crystals, two tentacles curl like a long mustache, and it leans on a twisted root cane.

fiche: Une souris habitée par un minuscule parasite lumineux qui lui pousse sur le dos, cachée dans les recoins rouillés.
apparence: A small rodent with a glowing fungal parasite growing out of its back; dominant colors black fur, toxic green and magenta.

stades.bebe: A round black mouse with huge ears and a tiny green bud on its back.
stades.enfant: The bud opens into a small glowing green sprout with one eye at its tip.
stades.ado: The sprout grows into a stalk with three eyes and the mouse's tail splits into two.
stades.adulte: A sleek mouse carrying a tall branching parasite stalk with glowing eye-bulbs and a split tail ending in green lights.
stades.ancien: The parasite becomes a gnarled mini-tree with a halo of glowing spores, and the mouse has a white whiskered beard.

fiche: Une créature à pattes fines dont l'œil unique grossit tout comme une loupe, rôdant dans les cristaux.
apparence: A multi-legged critter with a single lens-shaped glassy eye on its body; dominant colors violet, glassy cyan-green and black.

stades.bebe: A round black bean body with one big glass-lens eye and four tiny legs.
stades.enfant: Two extra pairs of thin legs appear and the lens eye gets a violet rim.
stades.ado: The body elongates into segments and two antenna-like eyestalks grow beside the main lens.
stades.adulte: A long segmented walker on twelve legs, its main lens huge and ringed by brass-like plates, with two eyestalks.
stades.ancien: Its lens is cracked like old glass, its legs are tipped with crystals, and spectacle-shaped plates sit over the eyestalks.

fiche: Une grosse limace iridescente qui laisse derrière elle une traînée lumineuse dans les forêts humides.
apparence: A slug-like creature with an iridescent oily shell plate and glowing slime trail; dominant colors iridescent black, magenta and toxic green.

stades.bebe: A plump little slug with two eye-stalks and a shimmering pink belly.
stades.enfant: A small iridescent shell plate appears on its back and the eye-stalks multiply to four.
stades.ado: The shell becomes a spiral with green glowing vents and frilled skirts grow along the sides.
stades.adulte: A long slug with a tall spiral iridescent shell, wavy side frills and a crown of six eye-stalks.
stades.ancien: The shell is covered in moss and tiny mushrooms, and its drooping eye-stalks wear little glowing beads like a wise elder.

fiche: Un petit être dont les bras sont des créatures indépendantes qui ont chacune leur avis, vivant dans les ruines.
apparence: A bipedal creature whose arms are separate little creatures with their own faces; dominant colors violet skin, magenta and dark green.

stades.bebe: A round violet body on two stubby feet with two tiny smiling bumps on its shoulders.
stades.enfant: The shoulder bumps grow into short arms ending in small faces with eyes and mouths.
stades.ado: The arm-faces lengthen into snake-like limbs and a ridged crest grows on its head.
stades.adulte: A tall upright creature with long arm-creatures that have jaws and eyes, a ridged crest and armored green belly plates.
stades.ancien: Its crest is cracked like old stone, the arm-creatures sport little beards, and it wears a frayed patchwork cloak.

fiche: Un long serpent couvert de cils ondulants qui nage dans les eaux pétillantes et toxiques.
apparence: A long serpentine body covered in waving hair-like cilia that shimmer; dominant colors toxic green, violet and iridescent black.

stades.bebe: A short round worm with big eyes and a fuzzy ring of cilia around its middle.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens and cilia spread along it, with a small fringe collar around the head.
stades.ado: Two feathery cilia fins grow at the neck and the tail splits into a fringed fork.
stades.adulte: A long sinuous serpent covered in rippling glowing cilia, with a large frilled collar and four feathery fins.
stades.ancien: Its cilia turn silver-white like a flowing mane and beard, with crystal beads tangled in them.

fiche: Un papillon étrange dont les ailes reflètent un autre monde, voletant au cœur des aurores.
apparence: A moth-like flyer whose wings are mirror-like panels with eye patterns showing swirling other-world reflections; dominant colors magenta, violet and silver-black.

stades.bebe: A round fuzzy caterpillar with one big eye and two tiny mirror buds on its back.
stades.enfant: The buds open into two small round mirror wings and feathery antennae appear.
stades.ado: A second pair of wings grows, each showing a painted eye, and the body slims into a moth shape.
stades.adulte: A large moth with four tall mirror wings showing swirling starry reflections and big eye patterns, with plumed antennae.
stades.ancien: Its mirror wings are cracked with golden repairs, its antennae droop like long brows, and a shimmering halo floats behind it.

fiche: Une bête faite de morceaux qui ne vont pas ensemble, née d'une expérience ratée dans un laboratoire en ruine.
apparence: A patchwork quadruped built from mismatched animal parts held by glowing stitches; dominant colors violet, toxic green and black.

stades.bebe: A round body with mismatched ears, one big eye and one small eye, on four tiny different legs.
stades.enfant: A crab claw replaces one front paw and a feathered tail appears, held by green glowing stitches.
stades.ado: A single curved horn and a bat wing sprout on one side, and its back grows a row of shell plates.
stades.adulte: A hulking beast with a crab claw, a hoof, a paw and a tentacle leg, one horn, one wing and a shell-plated back.
stades.ancien: Its stitches glow like golden scars, moss covers its shell plates, and an old brass bolt crown sits on its head.

fiche: Un sage aux mille regards qui flotte dans les ruines arcaniques et voit à travers les murs.
apparence: A floating stone-and-flesh sphere covered in eyelids, surrounded by orbiting rune rings; dominant colors deep violet, magenta and gold-flecked black.

stades.bebe: A small round sphere with three closed sleepy eyelids and a tiny rune ring floating above.
stades.enfant: The three eyes open and two small stone hands float beside its body.
stades.ado: More eyes open across the sphere and a rocky collar with rune carvings forms around it.
stades.adulte: A massive sphere studded with many eyes, a central giant eye, floating stone hands and three orbiting rune rings.
stades.ancien: Its rocky collar is cracked and mossy, its central eye wears heavy lids like brows, and a book of runes orbits with the rings.

fiche: Une pieuvre céleste qui nage dans les nuages d'orage en se tenant par ses ventouses aux éclairs.
apparence: A flying octopus-like creature with a balloon mantle and membrane-webbed tentacles; dominant colors magenta, violet and crackling toxic green.

stades.bebe: A round magenta balloon head with big eyes and four short floppy tentacles.
stades.enfant: The tentacles multiply to six and thin membranes appear between them like little wings.
stades.ado: The mantle grows fins on top and green sparks crackle along its tentacle tips.
stades.adulte: A large sky octopus with a finned balloon mantle, eight long tentacles webbed into gliding wings and glowing suckers.
stades.ancien: Its mantle is wrinkled with lightning-shaped scars, long tentacles curl into a beard, and a ring of tiny storm clouds circles it.

fiche: Une créature géométrique dont chaque patte se divise en pattes plus petites, née au cœur des cristaux.
apparence: A crystalline multi-legged creature whose body repeats itself in smaller copies, with faceted iridescent shell; dominant colors iridescent black, violet and magenta.

stades.bebe: A round faceted gem body with two big eyes on three tiny crystal legs.
stades.enfant: Six legs appear, each tipped with a smaller copy of its gem body.
stades.ado: The legs branch into forked segments and a triangular crest of crystal plates rises on its back.
stades.adulte: A towering spidery walker whose legs branch again and again into smaller legs, with a spiral crystal crest and a glowing core.
stades.ancien: Its facets are clouded and veined like marble, its crest forms a halo of tiny repeating crystals, and dust settles on its joints.

fiche: Un serpent tordu en boucle sans fin qui se mord la queue et apparaît là où l'espace se plie.
apparence: A twisted ribbon-like serpent whose body loops into an endless twisted band, with a face at both ends; dominant colors violet, magenta and starry iridescent black.

stades.bebe: A short round worm with a cute face on each end curled into a tiny ring.
stades.enfant: The body flattens into a ribbon with a half twist and small fin frills grow along its edges.
stades.ado: The ribbon lengthens into a figure-eight loop and both heads grow little curved horns.
stades.adulte: A long twisted ribbon serpent looping endlessly, both heads horned, its band showing starry patterns and glowing edges.
stades.ancien: Its band is etched with ancient runes and cracks, both heads have long whiskers, and a ring of floating stars orbits the loop.

fiche: La reine des aberrations, une masse vivante d'où naissent toutes les mutations, endormie au fond des ombres cosmiques.
apparence: A colossal living mass of shifting iridescent matter with eyes, tentacles and a glowing heart; dominant colors deep violet, magenta and toxic green.

stades.bebe: A small round iridescent blob with one big gentle eye and a tiny glowing heart inside.
stades.enfant: Short tentacles ripple from its base and two more eyes open beside the first.
stades.ado: The mass rises into a tall dome with a crown of thin spires and many small eyes blinking across it.
stades.adulte: A colossal shifting mass with a spired crown, dozens of eyes, many long tentacles and a radiant green heart in its chest.
stades.ancien: Its spired crown becomes a halo of floating crystals, its surface is veined like old marble, and tiny baby aberrations cling to it.
